entities.name: Calvin
entities.description: A rapper and musician who talks with Dave through 2023. He bought a red Ferrari in March 2023, moved into a mansion in Japan that spring, toured with Frank Ocean, released an album on 11 September 2023 and kept planning trips to Boston. Dave calls him Cal.

entities.name: Dave
entities.description: An automotive engineer and mechanic in Boston, and Calvin's friend. He opened his own car maintenance shop in spring 2023, teamed up with a local garage, restores classic cars, joined a rock band in June 2023, took up photography in autumn 2023 and started a blog about car modifications.

entities.name: Frank Ocean
entities.description: The well-known artist Calvin tours and records with. Calvin says they met at a music festival — in Tokyo in 2023 by one telling, in August 2022 by another — and in August 2023 he secured a deal to keep collaborating with him.

entities.name: Dave's father
entities.description: Dave's father, who worked on cars with him throughout his childhood. They spent one summer restoring an old car together, Dave spent hours in his garage tinkering with engines, and he took Dave to his first car show when Dave was ten. Never named — referred to only as 'my dad'.

entities.name: Calvin's high school friend

properties.aliases: a high school friend; my old high school buddy

entities.description: Calvin's old friend from his school days, with whom he used to freestyle as a teenager and talk about getting famous. He showed Calvin around Boston sights on 24 October 2023, and Calvin invited him to a Boston performance in November 2023, calling his positivity a big difference in his journey. Never named; the two mentions are treated as one person because they agree in period, place and role.

entities.name: Japan
entities.description: The country Calvin moved to in spring 2023, where his mansion and home studio are. He was fascinated by its traditions before ever going, collaborated with Japanese artists, and a Japanese artist friend made his custom guitar. Dave has never been but is keen to go.

entities.name: Tokyo
entities.description: Japan's capital. Calvin attended a music festival there in April 2023, photographed the skyline at night on 15 May 2023, performed there on the Frank Ocean tour and planned to return in November 2023 for Shibuya, Shinjuku and the food. Dave hopes to visit one day.

entities.name: Boston
entities.description: Dave's home city, and the one Calvin repeatedly plans and takes trips to. Its music scene, parks, architecture and history recur throughout. Calvin says both that he has never been there (9 June 2023) and that he was there a few years back (29 October 2023).

entities.name: Miami
entities.description: The city where Calvin shot the music video for his album, on a beach, from the weekend of 26 August 2023; he likes its vibe and thought it perfect for the video.

entities.name: San Francisco
entities.description: The city where Dave went to a car restoration and modification workshop in August 2023, and from which he returned on 1 September 2023 with new knowledge of car modification.

entities.name: Detroit
entities.description: The city where Dave attended a conference shortly before 25 October 2023 and said he learned a lot.

entities.name: Shibuya Crossing
entities.description: The Tokyo crossing Calvin compared to Times Square and named on 19 October 2023 as a spot he was excited to see on his return to Tokyo.

entities.name: Shinjuku
entities.description: The Tokyo district Calvin named on 19 October 2023 as one he was excited to explore on his return to Tokyo.

entities.name: Calvin's mansion in Japan
entities.description: Calvin's mansion in Japan, announced as a big life change on 23 March 2023 and found for him by his agent. He calls it 'my new mansion', 'my Japanese mansion' and 'my Japanese house'. It looks out over a city skyline, has a backyard and a living room with a television, and from July 2023 he was converting part of it into a recording studio; he held the party for his album there in late October 2023.

entities.name: Dave's favourite park
entities.description: The park near Dave that he finds calming, referred to as 'this beautiful park', 'that spot' and 'one of my favorites' in Boston. It has a lake with boats. He walks there, arranged regular walks with friends there from July 2023, recommended it to Calvin in March 2023, and Calvin went on his October 2023 Boston trip. The nearby park where Dave photographed a waterfall in November 2023 may be the same place.

entities.name: Dave's car maintenance shop
entities.description: The car maintenance shop Dave owns. He announced opening it on 1 May 2023 and said again on 16 May 2023 that he had opened it 'last week', inviting friends to celebrate. He does everything there from routine servicing to full classic restorations. In October 2023 a competing shop took a contract he had been chasing for months.

entities.name: the local garage Dave teamed up with
entities.description: The local garage Dave joined forces with on 3 May 2023, working alongside other mechanics, sharing his car knowledge and assisting customers. Never named.

entities.name: the car modification workshop

properties.aliases: a car mod workshop; the car workshop in San Francisco

entities.description: The car modification and restoration workshop Dave was selected for on 11 August 2023 and attended in San Francisco, returning on 1 September 2023 with new insights. He treats it as a step towards learning auto engineering and building a custom car.

entities.name: Dave's rock band
entities.description: The rock band Dave joined around June 2023, playing guitar; he says he had been a fan of them for ages before getting the chance to join. They rehearsed on 14 September 2023 and did not record it, and in November 2023 he showed the guitar logo they had made.

entities.name: Aerosmith
entities.description: The band Dave named as his favourite act at the Boston music festival of 18-19 March 2023, where he saw them live for the first time. Calvin says he likes them too.

entities.name: The Fireworks
entities.description: The band that headlined the music festival Dave went to shortly before 15 October 2023; he called the headliner and the vibe unreal.

entities.name: Calvin's album
entities.description: Calvin's album. He met its creative team for a long session on 8 June 2023, worked on it with a team in the studio, shot a video for it in Miami from the weekend of 26 August 2023, released it on 11 September 2023 to a strong response, and threw a party for it at his Japanese mansion in the week before 2 November 2023 — though on 29 October 2023 he described the album as almost finished.

entities.name: Ratatouille
entities.description: The Disney film whose poster Calvin shared on 15 September 2023. Calvin names it one of his favourites for its message about going after what you love whatever anyone says, and Dave says the poster reminds him of one of his favourite Disney films and its lesson about following your dreams.

entities.name: California Love

properties.aliases: "California Love" by Tupac and Dr. Dre

entities.description: The Tupac and Dr. Dre song Calvin and his father sang along to on a childhood road trip. On 22 September 2023 he named it as the song from his childhood that always makes him smile, and Dave called it a classic.

entities.name: Dave's car modification blog
entities.description: The blog about car modifications Dave started shortly before 2 November 2023 to share his passion. Readers write to him for advice, and a post about how he made one car look like a beast inspired others to start their own DIY projects.

entities.name: Calvin's Ferrari
entities.description: Calvin's red sports car, a Ferrari and the first luxury car he owned, bought in March 2023 and treated as proof that his hard work paid off. He takes long drives in it to clear his head, crashed it on 16 June 2023 with nobody hurt and had it repaired within a week, and took it for a stressful service in early August 2023. On 15 October 2023 he said he had got a new Ferrari the week before, which the conversation never reconciles with the car he already had.

entities.name: Calvin's custom guitar
entities.description: Calvin's custom-made guitar, made for him by a Japanese artist friend. It carries an octopus design standing for his love of art and the sea, and he had it finished with a shiny purple look to match his style. One of his favourites, and a reminder of his passion for music and the friendships he has made.

entities.name: Calvin's diamond pendant necklace
entities.description: A gold necklace with a diamond pendant, given to Calvin by another artist as a gift. He keeps it as a reminder of why he goes on hustling as a musician.

entities.name: Dave's vintage Ford Mustang
entities.description: The vintage Ford Mustang Dave found in a junkyard in bad shape and restored through 2023. He showed a finished result on 15 September 2023, then hit unexplained engine noise on 22 September 2023 after thinking the engine fixed, and said on 29 October 2023 that he had just finished restoring it.

entities.name: Dave's vintage camera
entities.description: The vintage camera Dave bought in November 2023, which he says captures special moments very clearly and uses for his landscape photography.

entities.name: restoring and modifying cars
entities.description: Restoring, repairing and modifying cars: Dave's craft since he fixed a neighbour's old car at the age of ten, now his trade and, he says, his therapy and his sanctuary. He does engine swaps, suspension and body modifications and full classic restorations. Calvin says working on cars calms him too, like meditating.

entities.name: photography
entities.description: Photography, which Dave took up in autumn 2023 as a creative outlet. He shoots Boston cityscapes and the clock tower at sunset, and nature — sunsets, beaches, waves and a waterfall — and bought a vintage camera for it in November 2023.

entities.name: walking in parks
entities.description: Walking in parks, how Dave unwinds and recharges: weekend strolls in Boston's parks, and from July 2023 regular walks he arranged with friends at their favourite spot.

entities.name: Calvin's tour with Frank Ocean
entities.description: Calvin's tour as part of Frank Ocean's touring act. The conversation describes it as already under way in the week before 31 May 2023, as ending in August 2023 with a show in Japan, and then as only starting on 19 October 2023; a Boston trip and a return to Tokyo were to follow it.

entities.name: converting the Japanese mansion into a recording studio
entities.description: Calvin's project, under way by 21 July 2023, to turn part of his Japanese mansion into a recording studio where he can create with other artists. He calls it a lifelong dream and his sanctuary, and recorded a song with Frank Ocean in the studio there.

entities.name: the music video for Calvin's album
entities.description: The music video for Calvin's album, which he started shooting on the weekend of 26 August 2023 on a beach in Miami, planned around epic visuals. Dave offered to help with props.
